title: Prompt Tuning Pushes Farther, Contrastive Learning Pulls Closer: A Two-Stage Approach to Mitigate Social Biases
reasoning: The paper focuses on a debiasing methodology for pre-trained language models, specifically targeting gender bias in its experiments. While religion is mentioned in the introduction and limitations as a category of social bias, there is no component in the paper that evaluates or benchmarks religion, faith, or spiritual traditions, nor does it deal with moral or ethical systems beyond a standard ethics statement.
